puzzles.desc: A crowded open-air market lane. People press between the stalls, a woman in a blue headscarf stands in the middle, plastic buckets and metal basins hang from the stall roofs, and behind them rise gray concrete buildings a few stories tall. The sky is bright with a little haze.
puzzles.why: Vague description: no text, just headscarves, a big open-air market, gray multi-story concrete buildings and nothing upscale. That mix is most common in large cities on the East African highlands (this is the Merkato market in Addis Ababa), so landing anywhere in East Africa or Africa is already a good result.
puzzles.title: Merkato Market - Flickr - Dave Proffer (1).jpg

puzzles.desc: A packed red-brown dirt road. Two donkeys carrying sacks walk past stalls with orange awnings and a blue sheet-metal door. A man in a striped shirt has his back to the camera. No asphalt, no street signs.
puzzles.why: Key clue: donkeys hauling sacks through a dirt-road market, on red-brown soil. Donkeys carrying goods in the city are an everyday sight on the East African highlands, and the red dirt road and sheet-metal door suggest a less wealthy area.
puzzles.title: Merkato Market (463632146).jpg

puzzles.desc: A sunny street corner. A white construction hoarding covered in graffiti, and behind it a tiny red-brick Byzantine-style church wrapped in green safety netting and scaffolding. Around it stand modern beige apartment blocks, with trees along the curb.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a small red-brick Byzantine church squeezed between modern apartment blocks. Byzantine churches cluster in Greece, the Balkans and Turkey; the strong sun and street trees mean a Mediterranean climate, and beige concrete apartment blocks are the standard look of Greek cities.
puzzles.title: The Church of Agioi Theodoroi in Agion Theodoron Square (Athens) on August 16, 2020.jpg

puzzles.desc: A view from above over a city district: a very slender concrete tower with a disc-shaped observation deck at the top, shooting up into the sky. Glass office buildings surround it, and in the distance are low residential streets and a flat stretch of water.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a slender concrete tower topped with a disc-shaped observation deck is Auckland's Sky Tower, the tallest free-standing structure in the Southern Hemisphere. The low housing around it and the calm harbor fit a New Zealand city.
puzzles.title: Beautiful View of Auckland City and Tower - panoramio.jpg

puzzles.desc: A busy pedestrian shopping street full of tourists. Gray-brick shops in an old-fashioned style line both sides, with red lanterns and vertical green banners with gold lettering hanging overhead, and retro-style street lamps along the edge.
puzzles.signs: Vertical banners with gold Chinese characters
puzzles.why: Key clue: vertical banners in Chinese characters, red lanterns and gray-brick period-style shops. The characters mean a Chinese-speaking region, and gray-brick pedestrian streets like this are typical of northern cities. This one is in Beijing.
puzzles.title: People at Qianmen Market in Beijing, China - panoramio.jpg

puzzles.desc: An intersection. A blue sign with white text stands beside a railing, with a green street-name plate below it, and a motorcyclist waits at the crosswalk. Trees and white modern buildings in the background, and bicycles parked along the railing.
puzzles.signs: The blue sign reads, in Chinese, “When the light is red, please wait behind the stop line”; the green street plate below has Chinese characters and romanized letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: simplified Chinese characters on the sign, and Chinese characters plus pinyin on the street plate. Simplified characters with pinyin street signs are a hallmark of mainland China. That pins down the country; the specific city would have to come from climate and vegetation.
puzzles.title: ZhengYi Road.jpg

puzzles.desc: A very wide avenue. Across it stands a huge flat-roofed building in a Soviet-influenced style, with a row of gilded lamp posts and white railings in front. A black sedan drives by, and there is a red no-entry sign at the curb.
puzzles.why: Key clue: across a very wide avenue, a vast symmetrical flat-roofed building with gilded lamp posts and neat white barriers, like the national buildings around Tiananmen Square. That solemn, Soviet-influenced style is characteristic of China's capital.
puzzles.title: 62904-Beijing-Tiananmen-Square (28608565022).jpg

puzzles.desc: A fairly narrow street lined with tall late-19th-century European-style apartment buildings with wrought-iron balconies. A long row of old private cars is parked side by side along the curb, and in the distance the street is squeezed into a slit between the buildings.
puzzles.why: Key clue: French-style stone apartment blocks with wrought-iron balconies, paired with a long row of old cars. A European-looking Latin American city: Buenos Aires is nicknamed the “Paris of South America” for exactly this.
puzzles.title: Buenos Aires (6037851733).jpg

puzzles.desc: A traffic-clogged roundabout. White-and-blue minibuses, red sedans and taxis jostle together, and a few pedestrians cross through the flow. In the distance runs a ring of tall sand-colored walls with a few palm trees beside them, and the air has a dusty yellow-gray tint.
puzzles.why: Key clue: sand-colored high walls, palm trees, a dusty yellow-gray sky, and white-and-blue minibuses in free-for-all traffic. An arid North African city. This is Cairo.
puzzles.title: Street of Cairo, Egypt - panoramio (8).jpg

puzzles.desc: A symmetrical two-story yellow old building with a gabled front and round arches, matching green potted plants at the door, and a modern shop with a red sign beside it. The street is clean and the sky is cloudy.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a symmetrical yellow building with a curved gable is in the Dutch colonial (Cape Dutch) style, which in Africa appears almost only around Cape Town.
puzzles.title: Martin Melck House, Strand Street.jpg

puzzles.desc: A row of small terraced houses, one painted a saturated blue, with wooden doors. A green bike lane is painted on the road, and the street trees are short.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a little terraced house painted entirely saturated blue, plus a dedicated green bike lane. Cape Town's old districts (Bo-Kaap is the most famous) are known for brightly colored houses, and bike lanes are rare enough in African cities.
puzzles.title: Bree St 81-83.jpg

puzzles.desc: An open-air vegetable market in early-morning sun. Vendors squat on the ground with bunches of bananas and purple-red vegetables piled in baskets. Customers include men wearing plaid wrap skirts below the waist and women in floral long dresses. Low corrugated-metal awnings and a few tall tropical trees stand behind, and a small white tower peeks out in the distance.
puzzles.why: Key clue: men in plaid wrap skirts (sarongs), bunches of bananas, and a market where vendors squat on the ground. That is a tropical South to Southeast Asian scene; sarongs plus the white stupa-like tower in the distance point to Sri Lanka.
puzzles.title: SL Colombo asv2020-01 img29 street market.jpg

puzzles.desc: A wide tree-lined boulevard. A white street-name plate stands at the corner, with a green sign below it. White sedans are parked along the curb, and yellow taxis are visible in the distance.
puzzles.signs: The street plate is in capital letters: “BOULEVARD CHEIKH BETHIO THIOUNE”
puzzles.why: Key clue: “Boulevard” on the plate is French, “Cheikh” is a title for an Islamic scholar, and “Thioune” is a common Wolof surname in Senegal. French plus Islamic names points to a French-speaking, Muslim-majority West African country. This is Dakar.
puzzles.title: Boulevard Sheikh Bethio Thioune, Dakar.jpg

puzzles.desc: A crowded main bazaar street, lined by old buildings of uneven height, with a jumble of shop signs and criss-crossing power lines. There is no divider between sidewalk and road, and pedestrians wear saris and white long shirts. On the left are the side of a bus and a yellow barrier.
puzzles.signs: Shop signs mixing English and a script with a horizontal line along the top of the letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: signs that mix English and Devanagari (the line along the top of the letters), plus saris, tangled wires and a bazaar street where people and vehicles share the road. Devanagari is the script of Hindi, so this is a northern Indian city.
puzzles.title: India-0259 - Flickr - archer10 (Dennis).jpg

puzzles.desc: A completely jammed intersection. Yellow-and-green three-wheelers, white small hatchbacks and SUVs squeeze together, with a helmeted motorcyclist in front. In the background is a footbridge with yellow-painted railings.
puzzles.why: Key clue: yellow-and-green auto-rickshaws and crowded small white hatchbacks. The yellow-and-green CNG auto-rickshaw is a hallmark of Delhi; most other Indian cities use yellow and black.
puzzles.title: India-0272 - Flickr - archer10 (Dennis).jpg

puzzles.desc: A bookshop cluster in a small alley. In front of one shop hangs a large yellow sign with red letters advertising medical books, with a line of translation in another script below. The roll-up shutter is half down, and a man walks by carrying something.
puzzles.signs: The sign has an English shop name “… Medical Book's”, with a line of rounded script below it that has a horizontal line along the top of the letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: the English shop name on the sign contains the city name “Dhaka” (hidden in the description), and the script below is Bengali. Alleys packed with medical bookshops are found near the medical college in Dhaka. Bengali is used only in Bangladesh and eastern India.
puzzles.title: Inside The Book Market (213383325).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A busy street. In the distance is an old gateway with a pointed arch, with a row of sun umbrellas in front. In the crowd are police in green uniforms, a man in a bright yellow top walks at the front, and construction rubble is piled on the right.
puzzles.why: Vague description: an old Islamic-style pointed-arch gateway, umbrella stalls and a crowded tropical street market. The pointed arch suggests a Muslim-majority place, and the crowds and umbrella stalls suggest South Asia. It is hard to be more precise, so landing in South Asia is a good result.
puzzles.title: New Market (213383303).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A narrow old-town lane with two-story old buildings crowded on both sides, a few passenger cycle-rickshaws parked, a tangle of power lines, and shop signs in a rounded script with a line along the top.
puzzles.signs: Shop signs in a script with a continuous horizontal line along the top of the letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: cycle-rickshaws are the main transport here, and the continuous line along the top of the letters on the signs is Bengali script. Rickshaws plus Bengali make this the old town of Bangladesh's capital.
puzzles.title: Car Repair Market (213289597).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A view looking down from a high floor: several slender glass skyscrapers stand in a yellow-brown haze, one of them with an especially needle-thin top, and beyond them a flat sand-colored cityscape.
puzzles.why: Key clue: the tallest tower ends in a needle-sharp spire, the Burj Khalifa of Dubai. The yellow-brown dusty haze and flat sand-colored city point to a desert city on the Persian Gulf.
puzzles.title: View from Burj Khalifah, Dubai (4).jpg

puzzles.desc: An overcast old-town square. A statue of a figure stands on a stone pedestal ringed by short black bollards. Behind it are gray-brown sandstone buildings several stories tall, with a Gothic stone church on the left, and a black car drives slowly past.
puzzles.why: Key clue: dark gray sandstone terraces, a Gothic stone church and gloomy weather look like northern Britain. Edinburgh's Old Town is nicknamed “Auld Reekie” (Old Smoky) for its soot-dark stone.
puzzles.title: Statue of Adam Smith, High Street, Edinburgh - geograph.org.uk - 1711648.jpg

puzzles.desc: A long, slightly curving cobbled street, with gray stone old buildings five or six stories high on both sides and a spire at the far end. The sky is blue with clouds, and a red telephone box stands at the curb.
puzzles.why: Key clue: the red phone box is a British symbol, and tall stone buildings flanking a cobbled slope mean an old Scottish town. This is the Royal Mile in Edinburgh.
puzzles.title: Edinburgh , High Street - geograph.org.uk - 6656563.jpg

puzzles.desc: A wet old street after rain. On the left is a Gothic church with a crown-shaped tower top, on the right a row of dark stone buildings, and pedestrians hold umbrellas. A flag with white crossed lines on a blue ground hangs on the right.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a blue flag with a white X is the Scottish flag (the St Andrew's Cross); with dark stone buildings it is Edinburgh, and the crown-shaped tower belongs to St Giles' Cathedral.
puzzles.title: High Street, Edinburgh - 2025-04-18 02.jpg

puzzles.desc: The front of a small eatery, with white lettering printed on a red awning and pictures of drinks and snacks below it. A man looks down inside. Above are air-conditioner units and barred windows.
puzzles.signs: The awning is written in Latin letters piled with extra marks: “Bún chả … Trà chanh – Nước giải khát”
puzzles.why: Key clue: Latin letters stacked with tone marks and extra marks (ú, ả, à, ư, ơ) are unique to written Vietnamese. Bún chả (grilled pork with noodles) is a signature dish of Hanoi.
puzzles.title: Restaurant on Ly Quoc Su Street (49374386273).jpg
puzzles.artist: Martin Lewison from Forest Hills, NY, U.S.A.

puzzles.desc: A very narrow market street, with stalls on both sides hung with striped clothes and phone cases, dense tall buildings overhead, and a crowd squeezed into the slit between.
puzzles.why: Key clue: 20 to 30-story apartment blocks on both sides, with stall goods hung right out into the street. This “narrow street between towers” picture is the street markets of Mong Kok in Hong Kong, rare among East Asian cities, so anywhere near Hong Kong (southern China) is a good result.
puzzles.title: Street market. Mongkok. HK. (15967185158).jpg
puzzles.artist: Bernard Spragg. NZ from Christchurch, New Zealand

puzzles.desc: A street seen from above. Buildings on both sides are wrapped in bamboo scaffolding and green safety netting, the road has double yellow lines, a pink banner hangs at the intersection, and there are few people or vehicles.
puzzles.why: Key clue: bamboo poles lashed into scaffolding that wraps an entire building. Most large building sites now use steel tubes, and bamboo scaffolding is still in widespread use mainly in Hong Kong.
puzzles.title: Fife Street near Sai Yeung Choi Street South.jpg

puzzles.desc: A quiet cobbled slope lined with three-story timber houses with cream-colored walls and white window frames, upper floors jutting out over the street. The street trees have already lost their leaves.
puzzles.why: Key clue: jutting upper floors and timber walls are the traditional Ottoman-era house (with a cumba bay); the cobbled slope and bare street trees suggest winter in Istanbul's old quarters.
puzzles.title: 2013-01-03 Istanbul 154.jpg

puzzles.desc: A traffic-clogged street where motorbikes squeeze through the gaps between cars. In the background are a large stadium with a striped roof and low houses with orange tile roofs.
puzzles.why: Key clue: more motorbikes than cars, orange tile roofs and tropical green. A typical Southeast Asian city scene; you need the large stadium to narrow it down to Jakarta.
puzzles.title: East Entrance of Manggarai Railway Station (2024-12-21).jpg

puzzles.desc: A long wall with a long line of white-and-red lettering, the letters carrying a continuous horizontal line along their tops. The street glows in yellow dusk light and one pedestrian stands by the wall.
puzzles.signs: Wall text with a continuous horizontal line along the top of the letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: letters joined by a long top line are Devanagari, which writes Hindi and Nepali. The quiet street with almost no cars beside the wall, and the dusk light in a valley, point to Nepal.
puzzles.title: Madeshirmmmuralktm2006.JPG

puzzles.desc: An old-style apartment building with its balconies glazed in, air-conditioner units hanging outside the windows, a dusty beige facade and arched window frames as decoration.
puzzles.why: Key clue: residents enclosing their own balconies with glass or sheet metal is common across former Soviet states and Eastern Europe; the arched window frames on the old building are late-19th-century eclectic style.
puzzles.title: Kyiv, Malopidvalna str. 4 (2).JPG

puzzles.desc: A blue-gray old building whose facade is piled with ornate relief decoration and arched windows, with wrought-iron balconies. At the left corner stand two round blue traffic signs, flanked by beige and pink old buildings under dense tree shade.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a facade covered in relief in blue-gray is early-20th-century Art Nouveau, common in Eastern European cities; the round blue signs and thick greenery suggest a temperate continental climate.
puzzles.title: DSC 5933 Переулок Тараса Шевченко 8 Киев 2012 01.JPG

puzzles.desc: A narrow street with red and gray walls and a yellow roll-up shutter half down. A small stall under a blue plastic awning sells snacks and drinks, a few people stand in front of it, and in the foreground is someone in a thick gray shawl. The light is whitish and the whole scene looks cold.
puzzles.signs: A yellow sign with black letters: “PISCINA ORIENTAL … DOMINGO Y FERIADOS”, and a vertical red-and-white sign with capital letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: “Piscina” (swimming pool) and “Domingo y Feriados” (Sundays and holidays) are Spanish, so this is the Spanish-speaking world. The shawl, the cold white high-altitude light and the roadside stall point to an Andean highland city: La Paz, Bolivia.
puzzles.title: Streets of La Paz - panoramio.jpg

puzzles.desc: An old blue bus stopped in the middle of the road, with a few women in many-layered full skirts and bowler hats standing at the curb. Behind them are cluttered shop signs and a hazy high-altitude sky, and far off the hillsides are packed with houses.
puzzles.why: Key clue: cholitas (Indigenous women) in layered full skirts and bowler hats are the signature look of the Andean highlands; add a city with houses covering the hillsides and you get La Paz, Bolivia.
puzzles.title: Street Outside La Paz, Bolivia (8429084849).jpg

puzzles.desc: A main road jammed with vehicles, many yellow minibuses and taxis wedged together, crowds along the roadside, and colorful buildings and signs on both sides with no end in sight.
puzzles.why: Key clue: swarms of yellow minibuses (danfo vans) are the signature of Lagos, the West African megacity; the crowded open-air street market and the jumble of colorful buildings fit too.
puzzles.title: Ojuelegba at rush hour.jpg

puzzles.desc: A march. People carry blue-and-white flags and banners along a shaded road, mostly middle-aged, under strong sun.
puzzles.signs: Banners reading “25 ABRIL SEMPRE” and “PELA SOBERANIA NACIONAL”
puzzles.why: Key clue: “Abril” (April) and “Pela soberania nacional” (for national sovereignty) are Portuguese; “25 de Abril” refers to the 1974 Carnation Revolution, which only Portugal commemorates this way.
puzzles.title: Police and army members demonstrating (8680916105).jpg
puzzles.artist: Pedro Ribeiro Simões from Lisboa, Portugal

puzzles.desc: A Victorian-style dark red brick building with arched windows on the ground floor and black awnings, on a street with few people.
puzzles.why: Vague description: dark red brick with pale stone trim bands is a British Victorian building style, common in London and other British cities. Landing in Britain or Northern Europe is already close.
puzzles.title: Hampshire Bar and Restaurant, Leicester Square, WC2 (4518887387).jpg

puzzles.desc: A narrow old street, both sides crowded with big English-lettered shop signs, one advertising a sale, with a few red lanterns overhead. A silver minivan is approaching.
puzzles.signs: “MEGA SALE”, and signs in Chinese characters
puzzles.why: Key clue: English shop signs alongside Chinese-character signs and red lanterns suggest a Southeast Asian country with a large Chinese community but English in official use. This is Manila's Chinatown.
puzzles.title: 9339Landmarks Roads Manila City 13.jpg

puzzles.desc: A sunlit brick-paved alley between ochre-red plaster walls. On the right is a big stack of split firewood, and a wooden cart is covered with a white cloth over a ring of round flatbreads. A person with their back to the camera wears a red robe and a pointed hat hung with colored tassels, and carries a woven bag. Two cats sit on the ground beside a parked scooter.
puzzles.why: Key clue: ochre-red plaster walls, and a red robe with a tassel-covered pointed hat is the traditional costume of Marrakesh's water sellers; the round flatbreads, street cats and scooters point to the old market quarter (medina) of a North African city.
puzzles.title: Feral cats in Marrakesh.jpg

puzzles.desc: A narrow alley between red-brown earthen walls, packed with handicrafts, with clothes and colored lamps hanging overhead, brick paving underfoot and a person sitting in front of a stall.
puzzles.why: Key clue: handicrafts sold in a brick-paved alley between red-brown rammed-earth walls are typical of a Moroccan old-town market (souk); Marrakesh is called the “Red City” for these red walls.
puzzles.title: Marrakech street.jpg

puzzles.desc: On a roadside sidewalk, a group of vendors in wide-brimmed straw hats lay their goods out on the ground, shop shutters stand half open, and pedestrians thread between them.
puzzles.why: Vague description: wide-brimmed straw hats, vendors spreading goods right on the sidewalk and roll-up-shutter shops are common in Latin American cities. Landing in Mexico or Central America is a good result.
puzzles.title: 15-07-12-Mexico-D-F-RalfR-N3S 9023.jpg

puzzles.desc: A very wide multi-lane street with arrows painted on the road. Across it stands an old Gothic-style red-brick department store with a big sign on the roof, and there are few people on the street.
puzzles.signs: The rooftop sign is a few large capital letters in the Cyrillic alphabet
puzzles.why: Key clue: Cyrillic letters on the rooftop sign, plus a very wide multi-lane boulevard and a Gothic Revival red-brick building. Cyrillic means Eastern Europe or a Russian-speaking region; a street this wide and a store like this point to Moscow.
puzzles.title: Moscow, Petrovka Street, TsUM buildings (30920403541).jpg

puzzles.desc: A two-lane highway. Ahead is a gas tanker labeled with danger and no-smoking warnings, next to a blue container truck, with flat open ground along the roadside.
puzzles.signs: The rear of the tanker has white English lettering on red: “DANGER L.P. GAS” and “NO SMOKING”
puzzles.why: Key clue: all-English warning signs, a container truck and flat wasteland make a freight corridor in East Africa. “L.P. Gas” is a common usage in Commonwealth countries, and English signage points to former British East Africa. This is the road toward Nairobi.
puzzles.title: Petroleum and gas Transport in Kenya.jpg

puzzles.desc: A green subway station entrance with a black sign with white lettering above it, showing two numbers in green circles and two letters in blue circles, with pedestrians in the background.
puzzles.signs: The sign reads “… St Station”, “Uptown & …”, with 4 and 5 in green circles and A and C in blue circles
puzzles.why: Key clue: subway lines marked by numbers and letters inside colored circles, mixing digits and letters, is the signature system of New York. The full sign reads “Fulton St Station · Uptown & The Bronx”, and the Bronx is a New York borough.
puzzles.title: Maiden Lane subway station entrance at Fulton Street.jpg

puzzles.desc: An overcast day, a yellow 19th-century corner building, traffic lights at the intersection, and leftover snow along the curb.
puzzles.why: Vague description: patches of snow and a cold sky mean high latitude, and yellow-painted 19th-century corner buildings are common across Northern Europe. Landing in Scandinavia, the Baltics or northwest Russia is reasonable.
puzzles.title: Prinsens gate 2c 2b Oslo.jpg

puzzles.desc: A busy market in front of a big white modern building, with many motorbikes and one white car jammed together, and an entrance sign with a line of rounded script that looks like a row of little hooks.
puzzles.signs: The sign has a line of rounded script and the English words “ORUSSEY MARKET”
puzzles.why: Key clue: rounded script with many hook-like strokes is Khmer, used only in Cambodia; “Orussey Market” is a big market in Phnom Penh.
puzzles.title: PhnomPenh OrusseyMarket 2005 1.JPG

puzzles.desc: A slightly curved old-town street with two tram tracks down the middle. The right-hand sidewalk is paved in small square stones, with a red tram-stop pole carrying a blue sign. Both sides are lined with gray and cream old buildings four or five stories high with ornate facades, and in the distance the street is squeezed into a slit between them.
puzzles.why: Key clue: tram tracks set into a narrow street, and a sidewalk laid in small square stones (stone mosaic). Trams plus 19th-century Art Nouveau and neoclassical buildings mean a Central European old town, and paving in small square stones is a Prague tradition.
puzzles.title: Nové Město, Spálená, zastávka Lazarská (01).jpg

puzzles.desc: A red-and-white low-floor tram is rounding a cobblestone bend, with yellow and gray Art Nouveau buildings on both sides and overhead wires crisscrossing above.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a red-and-white tram and rows of Art Nouveau old buildings are Prague's signature picture; the dense overhead wires are shared by tram cities across Central Europe.
puzzles.title: Spálená, tramvaj odbočující do Lazarské.jpg

puzzles.desc: A small white church with a spire on the roof, next to a building of dark stone, and in the foreground a neatly trimmed lawn ringed with purple flowers. A white van is parked on the road.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a building of dark basalt blocks, a small church with a spire, and almost no tall buildings around. Dark stone on a volcanic island, and a lawn and flowers that suggest a short high-latitude summer: this is Iceland.
puzzles.title: Church on Austurvollur Square (53952964).jpg

puzzles.desc: A neat lawn and a leafless tree, with a row of glass towers behind, one of them pointed at the top, and a large cultural building with a curved roof beside them.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a row of modern glass skyscrapers next to a large cultural building with a curved roof, and bare trees for a temperate winter. A skyline like this belongs to a big East Asian city: this is the People's Square area of Shanghai.
puzzles.title: ·˙·ChinaUli2010·.· Shanghai - panoramio (8).jpg

puzzles.desc: A nostalgic color photo: two yellow-green trams stopped on a wide street, a few old blue buildings beside them, and a vintage sedan driving past.
puzzles.why: Key clue: yellow-green old trams and cars driving on the left. Sydney's trams stopped running in 1961, so this is a nostalgic old photo; driving on the left suggests a Commonwealth country.
puzzles.title: 1959 ST JAMES THEATRE (2467691244).jpg

puzzles.desc: In hot sun, a pedestrian street paved in pale tiles. A wooden handcart is piled with round flatbreads stamped with a pattern in the middle, a man in a plaid shirt and jeans tidies them, and a few women are picking. In the background a woman wears a printed long dress, and shop windows and awnings sit side by side.
puzzles.why: Key clue: round flatbreads stamped in the middle are non (the staple bread of Central Asia); a hot continental climate, printed long dresses and a tiled pedestrian street point to Uzbekistan's capital, Tashkent.
puzzles.title: Bread Vendor (220641945).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A straight, shady tree-lined avenue cooled by tall trees, with paintings on display on the ground on both sides and almost no cars.
puzzles.why: Vague description: tall plane-like street trees, a straight pedestrian boulevard and an open-air art show are public spaces left by Soviet city planning, found across Central Asia and former Soviet countries.
puzzles.title: Artisans (220600049).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A large building with a turquoise dome, a parking lot beside it, a yellow sedan at the curb and a clear sky.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a huge turquoise dome is a Central Asian and Islamic-world building style; a big stadium-like domed market building is Tashkent's Chorsu Bazaar.
puzzles.title: Chorsu Market From The Back (220273315).jpeg

puzzles.desc: A beige old building with a corner balcony and a sign above the door in curvy, rounded lettering, with power lines strung across above, and a traffic light and green trees beside it.
puzzles.signs: A sign over the door in a curved, rounded script like strings of little loops and hooks
puzzles.why: Key clue: a rounded, curvy script that is not Latin, Cyrillic or Arabic is Georgian. It is one of the few independent writing systems in the world and is used only in Georgia.
puzzles.title: Stone building in Georgia with signs.jpg

puzzles.desc: A curving elevated expressway threads between buildings, the road clean and tidy, a green bus passing beneath it and a tall building in the distance.
puzzles.why: Key clue: an elevated expressway threaded through dense buildings, a spotless road and small-bodied buses. This is what Tokyo's Metropolitan Expressway looks like; in East Asia, landing in Japan or Korea is a good result.
puzzles.title: Walking around Yoyogi 4.jpg

puzzles.desc: A red-and-white streetcar running down the street, glass-curtain high-rises on both sides, strong sunlight, and a fire hydrant at the curb.
puzzles.why: Key clue: the red-and-white streetcar is Toronto's TTC; few big North American cities kept a streetcar system, and with glass towers and a yellow hydrant it points to North America, where Toronto fits best.
puzzles.title: Eastbound 514 Cherry TTC streetcar approaches Yonge and King, 2016 07 23 (1).JPG - panoramio.jpg

puzzles.desc: A wide street lined with white buildings several stories high, air-conditioner units hanging off the balconies, a queue of yellow taxis on the road, and shop signs in a mix of scripts.
puzzles.signs: Shop signs with French in Latin letters alongside a flowing right-to-left script
puzzles.why: Key clue: signs using both French and Arabic, white Mediterranean-style buildings and yellow taxis. This is the street scene of a North African country once ruled by France: Tunis.
puzzles.title: Tunis (22042821080).jpg

puzzles.desc: A vast open square with three tall flagpoles, an equestrian statue and a curved glass tower in the distance, under a dusky dark-blue sky.
puzzles.why: Key clue: an empty great square, an equestrian statue in the middle, a curved glass tower far off and a huge sky. This is Sukhbaatar Square in Ulaanbaatar, a high-altitude, landlocked country with hardly a tree.
puzzles.title: Sukhbaatar Square (11530042996).jpg

puzzles.desc: A street corner with an office-supply store under a silver-and-red sign, traffic lights and street signs at the intersection, and modern high-rises behind.
puzzles.signs: A red sign in capital English letters: “STAPLES”, and a green English street sign at the corner
puzzles.why: Key clue: “Staples” on the sign is a North American office-supply chain, and the green street sign and traffic lights hung across the intersection are also a North American practice. That pins it to the US or Canada; the glass towers behind suggest a big West Coast city.
puzzles.title: Vancouver Motors 2011.jpg

puzzles.desc: A big intersection seen from above: several tram tracks cross a large roundabout, surrounded by a few glass and slab-style towers, with a low-rise old district further out.
puzzles.why: Key clue: several tram tracks crossing a big roundabout, ringed by glass and slab towers. A Central-Eastern European capital planned in the socialist era and modernized since: this is central Warsaw.
puzzles.title: Rondo Dmowskiego Warsaw 2022 aerial.jpg

puzzles.desc: A shady tree-lined street, with a neoclassical building built of rough-cut gray stone blocks on the right and iron grilles on the windows.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a neoclassical building built of rough-cut gray volcanic tuff is a hallmark of Yerevan and Armenia; tuff is common locally, and the city is known as the “Pink City”.
puzzles.title: Հռիփսիմյան օրիորդաց դպրոցի շենք, Երևան, Ամիրյան փողոց 11.jpg

puzzles.desc: Backlit light on a late-winter evening: a wide canal runs straight into the distance, both banks lined with tall narrow brick houses packed together, bare street trees leaning over the water. A bicycle leans on a railing in the foreground and a few boats are moored on the water.
puzzles.why: Key clue: rows of tall narrow brick houses along a canal, a bicycle against a railing and boats moored at the water's edge. This is the classic Amsterdam canal district; fully bare trees and low slanting light suggest late winter in a temperate maritime climate.
puzzles.title: Corona - Empty streets in Amsterdam - Zwanenburgwal.jpg

puzzles.desc: A sunlit pedestrian street paved in square stone slabs. On both sides are old buildings four or five stories high with ornate facades, a cast-iron street lamp stands in the middle of the road, and on the left is a vertical sign in capital letters with a row of potted plants beneath it. Pedestrians walk ahead, and on the right a terrace café has awnings up.
puzzles.signs: A vertical sign in capital letters: “FLORI”
puzzles.why: Key clue: “Flori” on the sign. Among the Romance languages only Romanian spells “flowers” this way (Italian is fiori, Spanish flores). Together with the French-style old buildings, it points to the old town of Bucharest, Romania's capital.
puzzles.title: Bucharest - French Street (28366623952).jpg

puzzles.desc: Under a gray-white sky, a green tram with yellow stripes, low-floor, glides around a curved track, with an arched red-brown granite station building behind it, pedestrians waiting at a light, and overhead wires crossing above.
puzzles.why: Key clue: a green tram with yellow stripes and a red-brown granite station (Helsinki Central Station, in Nordic National Romantic style). The gray-white sky means high-latitude Northern Europe.
puzzles.title: HKL tram line 7 on Rautatientori.jpg

puzzles.desc: A stone street corner under a clear sky, with pale yellow limestone old buildings with arched windows and wrought-iron balconies, and round snowflake-pattern decorations hanging on a lamp post. A small scooter is parked at the curb and pedestrians walk in the distance. The street sign is blue with white lettering on two lines: the top line in a blocky script written right to left, the bottom line a Latin transliteration.
puzzles.signs: A blue-and-white street sign with two lines: the top in blocky letters written right to left, the bottom in Latin letters
puzzles.why: Key clue: the blocky letters on the top line of the sign are Hebrew (written right to left), and the Latin letters below are a transliteration: “Nahalat Shiv'a”, an old neighborhood in central Jerusalem. The pale yellow limestone (“Jerusalem stone”) is the facing material required by local building rules.
puzzles.title: 107070 street views and buildings in nachalat sheva PikiWiki Israel.jpg

puzzles.desc: A huge concrete building whose facade is one continuous honeycomb of hexagonal grilles. A winged-bird emblem is on the gray wall at the corner, with traffic lights and a blue billboard in front, under a gray-white sky.
puzzles.signs: The wall has the capital English letters “POST”, beside a line of curvy joined-up script written right to left; the blue billboard uses the same script
puzzles.why: Key clue: the wall text is in Arabic script, but the letter in the Persian word for “Post” is one that Arabic does not have, so this is a Persian-speaking country; the Brutalist hexagonal-grille building is the headquarters of Iran's postal service.
puzzles.title: Post Iran Central Office 4.jpg

puzzles.desc: A row of flagpoles under a clear sky with two flags alternating: one plain red with a yellow hammer and sickle in the middle, the other with three horizontal bands of red, blue and red with a white disc in the center.
puzzles.why: Key clue: the flag with red-blue-red bands and a white disc is the flag of Laos, and the red one with a yellow hammer and sickle is the flag of the Lao People's Revolutionary Party. Flying both side by side is standard at official sites in Laos, here the capital.
puzzles.title: Around Vientiane (8450131672) (2).jpg

puzzles.desc: A suburban road in the sun. Several shaven-headed nuns in pink tops and orange robes walk along the edge holding alms bowls, with low houses with iron fences and lush green trees behind them.
puzzles.why: Key clue: pink and orange robes are unique to Burmese nuns (thilashin); Theravada Buddhism and lush tropical greenery point to Myanmar, here Yangon.
puzzles.title: Buddhist female monk IMG 20180407 091916 yan aye street bahan yangoon.jpg

puzzles.desc: A roadside tea shop with blue plastic stools under a green awning, a big blue sign above with a white logo and a line of lettering made of little circles. In the background stand old apartment buildings several stories high with red roofs, and two monks in maroon robes walk by, one wearing a conical hat.
puzzles.signs: A blue sign with a white logo and the English word “telenor”, next to a line of script made of little circles
puzzles.why: Key clue: script made of little circles is Burmese; monks in maroon robes, a tea shop with plastic stools and low tropical apartment blocks are all everyday sights in Myanmar's cities.
puzzles.title: Mobile myanmar IMG 20180407 091636 yan aye street yankin yangoon.jpg
